sub: Build a business that runs without you. Then go live the life it pays for.
forTxt: Ninety days, one course a week, with me on the call every week. For anyone building an online business — creatives, agency owners, and every kind of service business, from the first client to the day it runs without you.

one.lead: This is the exact process I've used to build my own companies and to train the people who now run them. It isn't theory. It's what I did, written down in order, so you can do it too.
one.pull: My process is simple: you build the business, and you build yourself. Not two projects. One.
paras: A finished business has a definition. You can leave it, sell it, or run it from your phone on the other side of the world — and it holds. Anything less is a job you own. Everything in these ninety days is built toward that finish line: time freedom, location freedom and financial freedom, designed in from day one instead of hoped for at the end.
pillars: Every week with me. Thirty minutes of teaching, thirty minutes of your questions. Every call is recorded.
Fifteen courses over twelve weeks, in the order I'd teach you one-on-one — plus tracks for your industry.
The guides, templates, scripts and systems we actually run our own agency on.
People building the same thing, at every stage. Post your numbers. Ask real questions.

stagesIntro: Everyone runs all ninety days, in order. Your stage tells you where to push hardest. Most people are one stage behind where they think they are. That's normal, and it's the fastest way through.
stages: No business yet. You want an online business and the freedom that comes with it.
Freelancer or solo operator. You find the work, do the work, chase the invoice. Feast or famine.
Real revenue, real clients — and every one of them needs you. Around $10–30K a month.
People on payroll, but you're still the bottleneck. Around $30–100K a month.
It runs without you. Now it's about scale, deals, and the life it pays for.
movesIntro: The program is ninety days: one move a month, one course a week, one live call a week. It's the same path I walked my brother through — from someone who just wanted to have a company, to running one fully remote at six figures a month.

moves.p: An offer people understand, a steady flow of leads, and you selling it with confidence. Cash coming in every week.
Someone else delivers. Systems, SOPs, a CRM, your first hires. Clients stay, and the work moves without you touching it.
The numbers run on a scoreboard, the team runs the day, and you run the company from your phone — anywhere.

under: Rich · Fit · Sick runs underneath all ninety days. Rich — the work, the learning, a rich life. Fit — train every day. Sick — mindset, reading, style, the standard you hold. The business and the person get built at the same time.
tenIntro: I've looked at a lot of businesses. When one is stuck, it's stuck on one of these ten — in any industry, at any size. Find yours, and go straight to the course that fixes it.
